import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    n = int(data[0])
    arr = list(map(int, data[1:1+n]))
    
    if n == 0:
        print(1)
        return
    
    min_val = min(arr)
    s = set(arr)
    
    if min_val > 1:
        print(1)
        return
    
    m = 2
    while True:
        if m not in s and m > min_val:
            print(m)
            return
        m += 1

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
